description: This file is an extension for CanvasWindowController that provides functionalities for creating and managing NSWindow or NSPanel instances, including positioning, resizing, and visibility handling within a macOS application dashboard. It contains methods for window/panel creation, repositioning based on anchors, frame validation, and persistence.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: Main class extended to include window and panel management functions.

methods.name: makeWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures either an NSWindow or a custom CanvasPanel based on presentation type.

methods.name: presentAnchoredPanel
methods.description: Displays the panel anchored to a specific location, activating the window and bringing overlays to front.

methods.name: repositionPanel
methods.description: Recalculates the panel position based on anchor, screen, and placement preferences, adjusting size and position.

methods.name: setPanelFrame
methods.description: Sets the frame of the panel on a specific screen, adjusting for screen bounds and visibility.

methods.name: defaultTopRightFrame
methods.description: Generates a default top-right corner frame for the panel based on screen size and layout.

methods.name: screen
methods.description: Determines the screen for a given anchor rectangle.

methods.name: screenContainingMouseCursor
methods.description: Gets the screen where the mouse cursor currently resides.

methods.name: isFrameMeaningfullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a given frame is mostly visible within a specific screen.

methods.name: constrainFrame
methods.description: Constrains a frame to stay within visible screen bounds, rounding position as necessary.

methods.name: windowWillClose
methods.description: Handles window close event, updating visibility state.

methods.name: windowDidMove
methods.description: Persists frame position when the window is moved.

methods.name: windowDidEndLiveResize
methods.description: Persists frame position when resizing ends.

methods.name: persistFrameIfPanel
methods.description: Stores the current frame if the instance is a panel, for restoration.
